summary: 66-year-old man from Craig drowned after his inflatable kayak capsized on a rock in Teepee Rapid (class II+) on the Yampa River; companion kayaked 24 miles downstream to Hells Canyon Ranch to report; NPS rangers searched by helicopter Sunday morning and recovered the body ~3 miles downstream
location: Teepee Rapid, Yampa River, Dinosaur National Monument
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE — month-only (May 2017); NPT republishes the NPS release: incident ~2 p.m. on a Saturday in May 2017 (exact Saturday unrecoverable); victim wore a PFD; identity withheld pending family notification; body transported to the Moffat County Coroner.
